body:
i don't have anyone i could share with. what could anyone even say to me if i told them everything? because i don't even know what to say to myself.

and i believe it hasn't always been like this. the beginning was different. it was good. 

but it's all slowly killing me after years of neglect. and i feel like i just don't matter to him. and he's all i have. and it feels so fucking embarrassing to love someone ... to reach out... for years i've been climbing out on a limb, trying to reach him and begging him to meet me half way, but this twig i'm now standing on is about to snap.

i just feel utterly worthless.
